{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'severity'
print("Unique values in 'severity':", df['severity'].unique())

# Check for duplicates in 'patient_id'
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_patients}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_counts.max()}")

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq (i.e., retested)
retested_patients = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()
print(f"Number of patients retested (sample_seq > 1): {retested_patients}")

# Confirm that the max sample_seq per patient is used for deduplication
# We will now deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the count of 'severe' in the deduplicated dataset
severe_count = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Number of patients with severe baseline disease: {severe_count}")
print(f"Total number of enrolled patients (deduplicated): {total_patients}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")

# Final output
severe_count, total_patients, fraction_severe"}
